structural_reason_measured: Under the frozen R117 profile with only one F1(43008)+one T(27521) and no decoys, the two builds remain device/host resident at replay (F1 dev 36864+host 4096, T dev 27520) and their evicted suffix is not written through (L3 coverage F1 40958/43008, T 2046/27521). T therefore needs no staging (suffix 1 token) and F1 needs only 2047 (<39321). Full L3 durability and non-residency both require eviction/write-back pressure (as supplied by the R119 decoys) which this no-decoy workload does not provide. The live host pool is near-saturated (free+evictable 28672 < F1+T 70529), so the write-back drain also cannot complete.
